description: This file defines the PageSetup class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, which manages various page setup options such as paper size, orientation, scaling, print ranges, headers, footers, and page order for spreadsheet worksheet printing configuration.

classes.name: PageSetup
classes.description: Represents and manages page setup configurations such as paper size, orientation, scaling, header/footer, print area, and page order for worksheet printing.

methods.name: getPaperSize
methods.description: Returns the current paper size setting for the worksheet page setup.

methods.name: setPaperSize
methods.description: Sets the paper size for the worksheet page setup, accepts constants like self::PAPERSIZE_LETTER.

methods.name: getOrientation
methods.description: Returns the current page orientation setting ('default', 'landscape', or 'portrait').

methods.name: setOrientation
methods.description: Sets the page orientation. Valid values are 'landscape', 'portrait', or 'default'.

methods.name: getScale
methods.description: Returns the current print scale percentage.

methods.name: setScale
methods.description: Sets the print scaling percentage; valid values from 10 to 400. Can also disable scaling by setting null.

methods.name: getFitToPage
methods.description: Checks if the 'fit to page' option is enabled for scaling.

methods.name: setFitToPage
methods.description: Enables or disables the 'fit to page' scaling option.

methods.name: getFitToHeight
methods.description: Returns the number of vertical pages to fit on when 'fit to page' is enabled.

methods.name: setFitToHeight
methods.description: Sets the number of vertical pages to fit; can update 'fit to page' option.

methods.name: getFitToWidth
methods.description: Returns the number of horizontal pages to fit on when 'fit to page' is enabled.

methods.name: setFitToWidth
methods.description: Sets the number of horizontal pages to fit; can update 'fit to page' option.

methods.name: isColumnsToRepeatAtLeftSet
methods.description: Checks if columns are set to repeat at the left margin.

methods.name: getColumnsToRepeatAtLeft
methods.description: Returns the array defining columns to repeat at the left.

methods.name: setColumnsToRepeatAtLeft
methods.description: Defines columns to repeat at the left margin.

methods.name: setColumnsToRepeatAtLeftByStartAndEnd
methods.description: Sets columns to repeat at the left by specifying start and end column labels.

methods.name: isRowsToRepeatAtTopSet
methods.description: Checks if rows are set to repeat at the top.

methods.name: getRowsToRepeatAtTop
methods.description: Returns the array defining rows to repeat at the top.

methods.name: setRowsToRepeatAtTop
methods.description: Defines rows to repeat at the top.

methods.name: setRowsToRepeatAtTopByStartAndEnd
methods.description: Sets rows to repeat at the top by specifying start and end row numbers.

methods.name: getHorizontalCentered
methods.description: Checks if horizontal centering is enabled.

methods.name: setHorizontalCentered
methods.description: Enables or disables horizontal centering of page content.

methods.name: getVerticalCentered
methods.description: Checks if vertical centering is enabled.

methods.name: setVerticalCentered
methods.description: Enables or disables vertical centering of page content.

methods.name: getPrintArea
methods.description: Returns the print area(s) as a string. Handles multiple ranges separated by commas.

methods.name: isPrintAreaSet
methods.description: Checks if a print area is set, either any or specific by index.

methods.name: clearPrintArea
methods.description: Clears specified print area(s).

methods.name: setPrintArea
methods.description: Sets or overwrites the print area(s) with specified cell range(s).

methods.name: addPrintArea
methods.description: Adds a new print area to existing print areas.

methods.name: setPrintAreaByColumnAndRow
methods.description: Sets a print area defined by start/end columns and rows.

methods.name: addPrintAreaByColumnAndRow
methods.description: Adds a print area defined by start/end columns and rows.

methods.name: getFirstPageNumber
methods.description: Returns the first page number for printing.

methods.name: setFirstPageNumber
methods.description: Sets the first page number for printing.

methods.name: resetFirstPageNumber
methods.description: Resets the first page number to default (null).

methods.name: getPageOrder
methods.description: Returns the page order (overThenDown or downThenOver).

methods.name: setPageOrder
methods.description: Sets the page order preference for printing.
